question: 'I Am No Messiah' is an autobiography of the actor _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonu Sood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sonu Sood**

 
 
• Bollywood actor Sonu Sood authored a book titled I Am No Messiah.
 
• With this book, the actor has shared his experience of helping migrant workers during the Covid lockdown. 
 
• It is a book written in the first person, revealing the emotional challenges the actor faced while extending help.
 
• Talking about the book, Sonu said in his statement, “People have been very kind and have lovingly named me the messiah, But I am no messiah.
 
• I simply do what my heart tells me to.
 
• It is our responsibility as human beings to be compassionate and help each other.” Sharing his thoughts on migrant workers, Sonu said, “I want to thank god for making me a catalyst in helping the help migrants.”
 
• The book is co-written by Meena Iyer and is set to be published by Penguin Random House India and is expected to be out by mid-December.
